South Surrey and White Rock real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
White Rock homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

White Rock, September 2026. Detached houses: 144 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 193 listed at month end and 20 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 37 over 4 months against an average of 148.8 listed, about 16.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 11 sold. condos and townhomes sold 94 over 4 months against an average of 188.8 listed, about 8.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 29 sold.
